$comment: Message catalogue. Keys are dotted paths, grouped by surface. This file is the complete English reference: it is what a missing translation falls back to, so a key missing from a translation degrades to readable English rather than to a raw key or a blank. When adding copy to the site, add it here first, then to the other catalogues. Placeholders are {name} and must survive translation untouched. Copy rules: no em dashes in prose, no 'X, not Y' constructions, one triad per page maximum.

nav.tellUs: Tell us what you're trying to solve

footer.body: Digital product & systems studio. We build the platforms, software, and brand systems behind your business, then hand them over so your team can run them.

hero.body: From custom digital products and client platforms to design systems and full-stack web applications. We architect, engineer, and deploy the complete system so your team can scale without bloat.
hero.orFullForm: Or open the full enquiry form
hero.note: No package to choose and no budget conversation up front. Describe the situation and a person reads it.

intake.title: Tell us what you're trying to solve
intake.description: Tell us the situation and we'll understand it before recommending anything. No package required, no sales call to get a sales call.
intake.lede: You don't need to know what you need yet. Describe the situation, and we'll understand it first.
intake.step1Body: In your own words. No package to choose, no budget conversation up front.
intake.step2Title: We read it and assign it
intake.step2Body: A real person picks this up internally. You get a confirmation that it landed.
intake.step3Title: We work out the approach together
intake.step3Body: The right shape of engagement comes from understanding the problem, not from a price list.
intake.noSla: No response-time promise on this page. You'll hear from a person who has read your actual situation.

form.intro: Four things we need. Everything after them is optional.
form.messagePlaceholder: The more specific you are, the more useful our first reply will be. What have you already tried?
form.messageHint: {n} characters minimum. A sentence or two is enough.
form.prefilled: We've pre-filled this from the service page. Change anything that doesn't match your situation.
form.contextHelp: It helps us prepare. It doesn't commit you to anything.
form.consent: We'll email you to confirm we received this. Your details stay with the Rhymvex team.
form.networkError: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
form.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

success.heading: We've got it.
success.line1: Your message has been received by the Rhymvex team.
success.line2: We've captured your details and what you're trying to solve. A real person will review your request and reach out to understand your business before recommending what happens next.
success.line3: You don't need to do anything else right now.
success.checkEmail: Check your email for a confirmation.
success.ratherTalk: If you'd rather talk it through first, a call works too.

situations.scales: You need a system that scales

problem.heading1: Most products don't fail on features.
problem.body: The pitch deck says one thing. The site says another. The product does something else. Every tool gets stitched together by hand, so every release drifts further from the core.
problem.fixHeading: So we build the system first.
problem.fixBody: The architecture, the data model, the design tokens and the components come before any single feature. Everything built afterwards connects to the same foundation, so your team ships in hours.
problem.p1Body: From UI/UX to code and design tokens, your team ships consistent releases without endless handoff friction.
problem.p2Body: Production-ready software built on modern foundations: fast, resilient, and ready to scale.
problem.p3Body: Every system, interface, and workflow is designed around real business outcomes and measurable conversion.

process.heading2: You know the price before step one.
process.body: Each step ends with something written down and signed off, so nothing gets reopened in week six.
process.s1Body: We audit what exists, then interview the people who built it. You get the two or three gaps that are actually costing you.
process.s2Body: We lock the architecture, user journeys, and core value proposition, and get them signed off.
process.s3Body: Digital product, tokens, components and production code, delivered as an engineered system your team can run.
process.s4Body: Your team gets production deployment, codebase walkthrough, and system docs. Afterwards we stay on a rhythm if needed.

work.body: We would rather show you nothing than show you something invented. These are the systems the studio built for its own use, made the same way a client's would be.
work.label: Studio system
work.coreBody: One unified token repository feeds web apps, native iOS/Android, and Figma. Changes compile and sync automatically via CI/CD, giving development and design a single source of truth.
work.portalBody: The custom software platform powering this studio. Intelligent multi-locale intake, automated qualification, interactive proposal engine, and a private client workspace with contracts and live billing.

contact.heading1: Tell us where the system hurts.
contact.body: Every engagement starts with understanding the problem. Nothing gets quoted until we both know what's actually broken.
